rule: null means no user-approved value exists; runtime must not invent a default

x2_strategy_independence_contract.meaning: For each couple, X2 remains strategically independent of X1: X2 may disagree with X1, ignore X1 advice, and pursue a different search trajectory.
x2_strategy_independence_contract.terminology_note: This strategic independence is distinct from the technical SIC/formal-system independence settlement meaning of role I.

minimum_resource_floor.policy: No agent has a fixed minimum resource guarantee. All eight agents nevertheless remain active/eligible until global settlement; lack of a fixed floor is not permission to declare an agent stopped.

professor.parameter_inspiration_source: 6_Multi-Dose_Concentration_Derivation_v6.1_with_TOC(2).pdf; user requested joint exploration before freezing parameters

child_to_x1_ci_contract.note: Child supplies creativity; it is not the executive/boss of X1 or the verifier.

sentinel.veto_semantics: No kill/stop semantics were specified. Current approved action is strategy change to BFS after at least two outlier conditions are simultaneously met.
sentinel.note: Exact statistical definitions of the outlier cutoffs remain unresolved and must not be invented.

quotient_hunter_source_documents: Redundancy-Quotient Geodesic Theory for Formal Proofs(1).pdf

communication_topology_beyond_within_cou.scope: All principal agents may talk across couples/roles.
communication_topology_beyond_within_cou.trust_boundary: Agent communication is untrusted information and does not enter BANK unless the mathematical content is independently verified.

individual_agent_stop_policy_before_glob.policy: No individual principal agent may stop before global certified settlement.

settlement_certificate_families.P: certificate proving the target in the protected formal system
settlement_certificate_families.R: certificate proving/refuting the target via its negation in the protected formal system
settlement_certificate_families.I: certificate establishing formal independence of the target from the relevant axiom/system context, i.e. neither target nor negation is derivable under the declared independence certificate method
settlement_certificate_families.C: certificate establishing contradiction/inconsistency in the relevant background assumptions/system
